officialText:
The term of a concrete testing laboratory license shall be one (1) year and may be renewed every year thereafter.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
